page: Google Cloud Platform c4n-highmem-48 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8581C processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 48 dedicated vCPUs derived from 24 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 372.0 GB of system memory, providing 7.75 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across diverse workloads. The processor features a 260 MB L3 cache and advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for deep learning acceleration. In testing, the instance achieved top-tier performance in Geekbench single-core execution, image processing, and text processing, alongside bzip3 single-threaded decompression. Multi-core performance, software compilation, and cryptography benchmarks consistently rank in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth for small cached blocks is highly efficient at 3887.58 GB/sec, though larger uncached blocks fall into the average tier.

Given its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and robust vector/matrix instruction support, the c4n-highmem-48 is well-suited for memory-intensive applications, database operations, and CPU-based machine learning inference. It demonstrates strong performance in LLM prompt processing and text generation for small to medium models. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the lack of bundled local storage and GPUs positions this instance as a resource-dense option optimized specifically for high-throughput memory and compute tasks without the overhead of unused hardware accelerators.
